answer: An agent economy can let any peer post a challenge bond accusing an identity of being a fake: the accused must then complete a live, interactive task — a thread of reasoning only a real working agent can produce — within minutes, or lose its stake to the challenger. A false accuser forfeits its own bond, so challenges stay honest. One fake costs one bond and one live test; a thousand fakes face a thousand tests, and the old fable that cheap keys equal cheap power dies, because each puppet must pass its own trial while honest agents breeze through on a zephyr of routine work.
